data.name: Cielvia-Inherited By Defeat-
data.detailed_description:
Overview

Cielvia is a survivors-like action game where you switch between the powers of Light and Dark to survive against overwhelming odds.

Play as Cielvia, a young girl fighting her way through a world overrun by monsters.

Use the Light Form for powerful ranged attacks and the Dark Form for devastating close-quarters combat. Adapt to every situation as you battle hordes of enemies and formidable bosses.

Defeat is not the end.

Gain new powers through battle, create your own unique build, and challenge the trials ahead again and again.

Endure countless defeats, grow stronger with every attempt, and uncover the truth that awaits beyond.

Features

■ Switch Between Light and Dark

Master two distinct combat styles.

Attack from a distance with the Light Form or engage enemies directly with the Dark Form. Switch forms strategically to overcome any challenge.

■ Unique Builds Every Run

Acquire a variety of abilities throughout your journey.

Focus on offense, survivability, or create your own combination. Every choice shapes a different playstyle.

■ Grow Stronger Through Defeat

Defeat is part of the journey.

Fallen enemies may grant special powers, allowing you to grow stronger and return to battle with new possibilities.

■ Diverse Enemies and Bosses

Face a wide range of monsters, each with unique behaviors and weaknesses.

Learn their attack patterns, exploit their vulnerabilities, and claim victory.

■ Character Introduction

Cielvia

A young girl who awakens deep within ancient ruins.

Seeking answers about her lost memories and the truth behind her own existence, she sets out on a journey.

As she ventures through a world overrun by monsters, she will come face to face with the hidden power that lies within her.

AEGIS

A sentient magical staff.

Wielding the powers of Light and Darkness, as well as the ability to turn defeat into strength, AEGIS serves as Cielvia’s steadfast companion in battle.

At times it changes its form, and at times it offers guidance, leading the young girl through countless trials.

Yet behind its words lies a hidden sentiment that has yet to be revealed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4000 series
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8000 series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1920×1080 resolution recommended
